title_alternatives: Earn $1 Too Much in Retirement — Pay $3,400 More
Why Your Roth Conversion Could Blow Up Your Medicare Bill
youtube_short.description: There's a hidden Medicare surcharge called IRMAA that hits retirees who earn even $1 over the income threshold. Most people trigger it by accident — through a Roth conversion, selling their home, or a Required Minimum Distribution. And the brutal part? The IRS looks back TWO years, so by the time you get the bill it's already too late to undo it. Plan your retirement income before you pull any triggers. One conversation with a CPA could save you thousands. #retirement #medicare #IRMAA #personalfinance #moneytrap
